children: Bajaj Finance Ltd. may launch a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) soon to raise up to ₹11,700 crore, sources with knowledge of the matter told CNBC-TV18.
The proposed QIP could be priced at a small discount to the company's current market price (CMP), with the funds intended to be used as growth capital, the sources added.
Bajaj Finance's board had approved a fundraise of up to ₹17,500 crore on October 1, 2026.
The proposed fundraise comprised two components: a QIP of up to ₹11,700 crore and a preferential issue of warrants worth up to ₹5,800 crore to promoter and holding company Bajaj Finserv.
On November 10, Bajaj Finance's board cleared the issue of warrants worth ₹5,800 crore to Bajaj Finserv. The warrants will be convertible into an equivalent number of equity shares of the company.

Under the proposed preferential issue, at least 25% of the consideration will be payable at the time of allotment of the warrants, with the remaining 75% payable upon the exercise of the conversion option.

For the QIP, the company will issue equity shares with a face value of ₹1 each to Qualified Institutional Buyers. Bajaj Finance will seek shareholder approval for both the QIP and the preferential issue through an Extraordinary General Meeting.
Bajaj Finance declined to comment on CNBC-TV18's queries.
How Bajaj Finance Fared In Q2?
Separately, Bajaj Finance reported a 28.8% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹6,367 crore for the September quarter.
Net interest income (NII), the company's core income, rose 23.6% to ₹13,335 crore from ₹10,785 crore in the year-ago quarter. Net total income increased 23% to ₹15,974 crore.
Assets under management (AUM) grew 26% year-on-year to ₹5.85 lakh crore as of September 30, 2026. The company added ₹37,680 crore to its AUM during the quarter.

Bajaj Finance booked 13.45 million new loans in the September quarter, an 11% increase from 12.17 million a year earlier. It added 4.42 million customers during the quarter, taking its customer franchise to 128.85 million, up 16% year-on-year.
Shares of Bajaj Finance are trading 0.7% higher on Wednesday at ₹1,072.3. The stock is now up 10% so far this year.

title: Bajaj Finance may launch ₹11,700 crore QIP soon, may price it at a small discount: Exclusive
